title: The Crack in the Teapot Glaze
youtube_title: The Crack in the Teapot Glaze | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Showing someone how to look is a kind of gift.
summary: At a meadow fence and a bucket of water, Una finds a crackle in the teapot glaze like dried mud in miniature. The wish to pocket it or poke it is real, but Una shows Eko how to look without disturbing it. Auntie Luz looks too, and they leave it where it is.
